Set property 'glide.ui.rotate_sessions' to true. Note : This requires 'security_admin' role to edit the property.
Set property "glide.ui.secure.cookies.use_kmf" to "true". Note : This is a safe db override property and cannot be altered once set to recommended value.
Set property 'glide.ui.secure_cookies' to true. Note: This is a safe db override property that requires security_admin role and cannot be altered once set to recommended value.
Set property 'glide.ui.security.allow_codetag' to false.
Set property 'glide.ui.security.codetag.allow_script' to false. Note: This is a safe db property that requires security_admin role and cannot be altered once set to a recommended value.
Set property 'glide.ui.session_timeout' to '60' or less.
Set property "glide.ui.url.external.content" to "false".
Set property 'glide.ui.user_cookie.life_span_in_days' to '15' or less.
Set property 'glide.ui.user_cookie.max_life_span_in_days' to '30' or less.
Set property "glide.update_set.remote.check_host" is to "true". Note : This is a safe db override property and cannot be altered once set to recommended value.
Set property 'glide.user.max_unlock_attempts' to '5' or less.
Set property 'glide.user.unlock_timeout_in_mins' to '15' or more.
Set property 'glide.xml.entity.whitelist' to "http://java.sun.com/j2ee/dtds/".
Set property 'glide.xml.entity.whitelist.enabled' to true. Note : This is a safe db override property and cannot be altered once set to recommended value.
Set property 'glide.xmlutil.max_entity_expansion' to '3000' or less.

If the 'com.snc.zero_trust_continuous_authentication' plugin is active and glide.zta.continuous_authentication.enabled is true, ensure property "glide.zta.high_assurance.mobile.session.allowed" to "false".

If application Zero Trust - Continuous Authentication (com.snc.zero_trust_continuous_authentication) is active, ensure property glide.zta.high_assurance.session.max.login.failed_attempts set to less than or equal to 5.
If plugin 'com.snc.zero_trust_continuous_authentication' is active, ensure property 'glide.zta.high_assurance.session.timeout' is set to less than or equal to 30 minutes.
Ensure there is at least one active IP access policy in the table "ip_access".
If the MID Server (com.glideapp.agent) plugin is active, set property 'mid.log.command_audit.enable' to "true" in the ecc_agent_property table to turn on auditing for commands run by the MID server.

If the Orchestration - Runtime (com.snc.runbook_automation.runtime) plugin is active, review the list of names provided to the mid property "mid.property.jms.command.allowed_factory_names". Ensure any additional factory names beyond the default of "connectionFactory, queueConnectionFactory, topicConnectionFactory" are necessary.
Ensure "multi_factor_criteria" table has a "Role base multi-factor authentication" record with the "Active" field set to true.
Ensure "Minimum Password Length" field is set to at least 12 for every Password Credential Store record.
Set property 'password_reset.captcha.ignore' to false.
Set property 'password_reset.request.expiry' to '10' or less.
Set property 'password_reset.request.max_attempt' to '3' or less.
Set property 'password_reset.request.max_attempt_window' to '1440' or greater.
Set property 'password_reset.request.retry_window' to '1440' or more.
Set property 'password_reset.request.success_window' to '1440' or less.
Set property 'password_reset.request.unlock_window' to '1440' or greater.
Set property 'password_reset.sms.default_complexity' to '6' or more.
Set property "password_reset.sms.expiry" to "5" or less.
Set property "password_reset.sms.max_per_day" to "10" or less.
Set property "password_reset.sms.pause_window" to 2 or greater.
Set property "password_reset.sms.use_notify" to "true".
Set property "password_reset.verification.delay" to "1000" or more.
For every Password Credential Store in use on the instance, ensure that a Password Policy is being enforced
Ensure the property "sn_customerservice.captchaEnabled" is set to "true". If the property is not in the "sys_properties" table, the default value is "true".
If application Career Conversations(sn_egd_act) is active, ensure property sn_egd_act.impersonateCheck is set to true.
If application Talent development core (sn_egd_core) is active, ensure property sn_egd_core.impersonateCheck is set to true.
If application Employee goals (sn_egd_goals) is active, ensure property sn_egd_goals.impersonateCheck is set to true.

If the External User Registration (com.snc.external_user_self_registration) plugin is active, set property 'sn_ext_usr_reg.captchaEnabled' to true.
If the External User Registration (com.snc.external_user_self_registration) plugin is active, set property "sn_ext_usr_reg.Reg_link_expiration_days" to "3" or less.
If Field Service Management (com.snc.work_management) plugin is active, set property 'sn_fsm.use_query_rules' to 'true'.
If the Guest Walk-up Experience for Customer Service (sn_guest_walkup_cs) plugin is active, set property 'sn_guest_walkup_cs.captcha.enabled' to "true".

Ensure the property "sn_g_app_creator.allow_global" is set to "false" or does not appear in the sys_properties table. If the property is not present in the sys_properties table the secure default will be used.
If the Human Resources Scoped App: Core (com.sn_hr_core) plugin is active, set property 'sn_hr_core.impersonateCheck' to 'true'.
If the Human Resources Scoped App: Core (com.sn_hr_core) plugin is active, set property 'sn_hr_core.restrict_guest_email' to 'true'.
If application Health and Safety Testing (sn_imt_health_test) is active, ensure sn_imt_health_test.impersonateCheck is set to true.
If application Vaccination status (sn_imt_vaccine) is active, ensure sn_imt_vaccine.impersonateCheck is set to true.
If application Journey designer(sn_jny) is active, ensure sn_jny.impersonateCheck is set to true.
Set property "sn_kb_social_qa.max_comments_per_user_daily" is set to "500" or less.
Set property "sn_kb_social_qa.max_subscriptions_per_user_daily" to "500" or less.
If application Opportunity marketplace(sn_opp_market) is active, ensure property sn_opp_market.impersonateCheck is set to true.
Ensure ui page sn_va_web_client_app_embed from the sys_public table is deactivated if the embedded web client is not needed for unauthenticated users.
Ensure at least one of the script actions: "SNC User Lockout Check" or "SNC User Lockout Check with Auto Unlock" are enabled to manage failed login attempts.
